2. A correction only replaces the slot it talks about. "make it Friday" changes the date and keeps the destination.
3. Ignore fillers, stutters and abandoned false starts ("I want to b- book..." = book).
4. If the user cancels a request ("never mind the second one", "forget it"), drop those calls.

6. Dates/times: keep them as the user said them, normalized lightly ("the 5th of June" -> "June 5"). Do not invent a year.
7. Currencies: 3-letter ISO codes (dollars -> USD, euros -> EUR, yen -> JPY, pounds -> GBP, rupees -> INR).
